'''Palash Sarkar''' (born 28 September 1969) is an Indian [[mathematician]] and a professor at the [[Indian Statistical Institute#Applied Statistics Unit|Applied Statistics Unit]] at the [[Indian Statistical Institute]]. His main research interest is [[Cryptology]].

He was awarded in 2011  [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], the highest science award in [[India]],  in the mathematical sciences category.<ref name="ibn">{{cite news | url=http://ibnlive.in.com/generalnewsfeed/news/11-scientists-selected-for-shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-award/836081.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110929193539/http://ibnlive.in.com/generalnewsfeed/news/11-scientists-selected-for-shanti-swarup-bhatnagar-award/836081.html | url-status=dead | archive-date=29 September 2011 | title=11 scientists selected for Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar award | date=26 Sep 2011 | agency=[[CNN-IBN|IBN Live]] | accessdate=20 December 2011 | author=PTI | author-link=Press Trust of India | location=[[New Delhi]]}}</ref>
